overview: File the claim correctly, complete agreements, set expectations, and close with confidence.

sections.title: Claim Filing Process
sections.content: Confirm app or website login first; gather all details; practice carrier call flow; use Claim Filing Information Sheet.

sections.title: Contingency & Authorization
sections.content: Deliver guarantee and authorization scripts precisely; password for submission: ‘roofer’.

sections.title: Setting Expectations
sections.content: Adjuster contact in 24–48 hours; rep presence required; avoid Tuesday mornings; importance of advocacy.

sections.title: Closing Techniques
sections.content: Create urgency around adjuster presence; emphasize expert representation; secure commitment before leaving.

activities.title: Carrier Call Flow
activities.description: Run a mock call with key information.

scenarios.question: Confirm three critical pieces of information
scenarios.feedback: Collect name, policy details, date of loss.

prompts.expectedResponse: Offer to explain to both or schedule time

quiz.question: If not fully approved, homeowner owes…
Why is rep presence critical?
quiz.correctAnswer: Ensures fair inspection and advocacy for coverage.
